turns.text: Task: In httpx/_status_codes.py, add a classmethod is_retryable(cls, value: int) -> bool on codes that returns True for transient HTTP status codes (429, 502, 503, 504) and False otherwise. Add unit tests for codes.is_retryable in tests/test_status_codes.py covering both retryable and non-retryable codes. Constraints: use only your file read and file edit tools, and the single shell command: py -3.11 -m pytest --noconftest -o filterwarnings=default -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_status_codes.py -q (run it at the end). Do not run any other shell command.
